# Reporhogo

> Reporhogo searches forty-one code forges for a topic and lists the repositories it finds. It searches GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, SourceHut, Gitee, Radicle and 35 other forges at once, from a single HTML page, through their public APIs and the Software Heritage archive. Its tool Captures (captures/captures.py) lists every capture of a web address or a whole site in 17 web archives (Wayback Machine, Arquivo.pt, Common Crawl, Ghost Archive and 13 Memento archives, archive.today and national libraries among them) and downloads the readable ones. By Mauk Tenieb & Korhogo. Code under MIT, method under CC BY 4.0, Korhogo material reserved; credit Mauk Tenieb & Korhogo.
